title_en: Funny Stories from Life (2/20): The Dog Who Learned to Open the Fridge
note_en: After a verb or adjective, 得 introduces how far a feeling or action goes: 王阿姨惊得差点叫出声 "Aunt Wang was so startled she almost cried out," and 场面滑稽得邻居看了都笑出了眼泪 "the scene was so comical that the neighbor laughed till she cried." English needs "so... that..."; Chinese just links the two parts with 得.
